title: Create an Upgraded Smart+ App Promotion Search Ads Campaign
content_data:
This article explains how to create an Upgraded Smart+ App Promotion Search Ads Campaign.

Depending on whether you need to run an iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign (DC), you can create either a non-DC or a DC App Search Ads Campaign. For detailed instructions on both configurations, refer to the following articles:
- [Create an Upgraded Smart+ non-DC App Search Ads Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-non-dc-app-search-ads-campaign/v1.3)
- [Create an Upgraded Smart+ DC App Search Ads Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-upgraded-smart-dc-app-search-ads-campaign/v1.3)
